recipes.title: Mediterranean Garden Salad
recipes.desc: Fresh and vibrant salad with tomatoes, cucumbers, lettuce, and paneer dressed in olive oil and herbs.
steps: Wash and chop tomato, cucumber, and lettuce.
Cube the paneer and lightly sauté if desired.
Mix vegetables and paneer in a bowl.
Drizzle olive oil, sprinkle oregano, salt, and black pepper.
Toss well and serve fresh.

ecoImpact.foodWasteSaved: Saved approx. 120g fresh veggies from spoilage
ecoImpact.carbonSaved: Reduced 0.3 kg CO₂ emissions vs packaged salad

recipes.tip: Use leftover cucumber and lettuce in smoothies or wraps to reduce waste.

recipes.title: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
recipes.desc: Classic comfort food with golden bread and gooey cheese filling.
steps: Spread butter on bread slices.
Place cheese and tomato slices between the bread.
Grill on medium heat until golden brown.
Serve hot.

ecoImpact.foodWasteSaved: Saved 80g bread from going stale
ecoImpact.carbonSaved: Reduced 0.2 kg CO₂ emissions vs takeout

recipes.tip: Toast leftover bread ends for croutons instead of tossing them.

recipes.title: Masala Omelette
recipes.desc: Spicy omelette with onion, tomato, capsicum, and a hint of coriander.
steps: Beat eggs in a bowl with salt and black pepper.
Chop onion, tomato, and capsicum.
Heat olive oil in a pan, sauté vegetables for 2 minutes.
Pour eggs over vegetables and cook until set.
Fold and serve hot.

ecoImpact.foodWasteSaved: Saved 100g vegetables from being discarded
ecoImpact.carbonSaved: Avoided 0.25 kg CO₂ emissions by cooking at home

recipes.tip: Use leftover chopped veggies from dinner prep to make omelettes.

recipes.title: Vegetable Pulao
recipes.desc: Aromatic rice cooked with peas, carrots, corn, and spices.
steps: Rinse rice and soak for 10 minutes.
Heat olive oil, sauté onion, garlic, and ginger.
Add chopped carrot, peas, and corn.
Add rice and water, season with turmeric and salt.
Cook until rice is done and fluffy.

ecoImpact.foodWasteSaved: Saved 250g mixed veggies
ecoImpact.carbonSaved: Reduced 0.4 kg CO₂ vs ordering fried rice

recipes.tip: Store leftover pulao in fridge; reheat with splash of water to prevent drying.

recipes.title: Paneer Butter Masala
recipes.desc: Creamy curry with paneer, tomato, butter, and spices.
steps: Heat butter in a pan, sauté onion, garlic, and ginger.
Add tomato puree and spices, cook until oil separates.
Add paneer cubes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Garnish with coriander and serve hot with rice or bread.

ecoImpact.foodWasteSaved: Saved 300g dairy and vegetables at home
ecoImpact.carbonSaved: Reduced 0.5 kg CO₂ vs ordering online

recipes.tip: Use leftover curry as sandwich filling next day.

recipes.title: Vegetable Sandwich
recipes.desc: Healthy sandwich with bread, cucumber, tomato, carrot, and lettuce.
steps: Spread mayonnaise on bread slices.
Layer cucumber, tomato, carrot, and lettuce.
Season with salt and pepper.
Close sandwich and cut diagonally.
Serve fresh.

ecoImpact.foodWasteSaved: Saved 150g fresh produce
ecoImpact.carbonSaved: Reduced 0.3 kg CO₂ emissions by home prep

recipes.tip: Wrap sandwiches in cloth instead of plastic foil.

recipes.title: Aloo Gobi
recipes.desc: Dry curry of potato and cauliflower, flavored with spices.
steps: Heat olive oil, sauté onion, garlic, and ginger.
Add potato and cauliflower, cook 10 mins.
Add spices and salt, cook until vegetables are tender.
Garnish with coriander and serve hot.

ecoImpact.foodWasteSaved: Saved 200g cauliflower and potato
ecoImpact.carbonSaved: Reduced 0.35 kg CO₂ emissions vs takeout

recipes.tip: Use potato peels to make crispy chips.

recipes.title: Fruit Yogurt Bowl
recipes.desc: Refreshing yogurt bowl topped with banana, apple, and honey.
steps: Slice banana and apple.
Spoon yogurt into a bowl.
Top with banana, apple, and drizzle honey.
Serve chilled.

ecoImpact.foodWasteSaved: Saved 200g fruits from spoilage
ecoImpact.carbonSaved: Reduced 0.2 kg CO₂ vs packaged snack

recipes.tip: Freeze overripe bananas to blend into smoothies.

recipes.title: Potato Peel Chips
recipes.desc: Crispy chips made from leftover potato peels.
steps: Wash potato peels thoroughly to remove dirt.
Pat them dry.
Toss peels with olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Spread on a baking tray and bake at 200°C for 15–20 mins until crispy.
Serve hot.

ecoImpact.foodWasteSaved: Saved 300g potato waste
ecoImpact.carbonSaved: Reduced 0.4 kg CO₂ emissions

recipes.tip: Turn potato peels into crunchy snacks instead of discarding.

recipes.title: Grilled Chicken Sandwich
recipes.desc: Juicy grilled chicken with fresh vegetables in a sandwich.
steps: Season chicken with salt and black pepper.
Grill the chicken in olive oil until fully cooked.
Toast the bread slices lightly.
Spread mayonnaise on bread and layer with lettuce, tomato, and grilled chicken.
Serve immediately.

ecoImpact.foodWasteSaved: Saved 150g leftover chicken and veggies
ecoImpact.carbonSaved: Reduced 0.4 kg CO₂ emissions by home-cooking instead of takeout

recipes.tip: Use leftover grilled chicken from dinner to make sandwiches the next day.

recipes.title: Chicken & Vegetable Stir Fry
recipes.desc: Quick stir fry with chicken, capsicum, carrot, and peas in light seasoning.
steps: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté garlic.
Add chicken and cook until lightly browned.
Add carrot, capsicum, and peas; stir fry 5–7 mins.
Squeeze lemon juice before serving and toss well.

ecoImpact.foodWasteSaved: Saved 200g leftover chicken and vegetables
ecoImpact.carbonSaved: Reduced 0.45 kg CO₂ emissions vs takeout meal

recipes.tip: Use leftover vegetables from fridge to reduce food waste.

recipes.title: Masala Scrambled Eggs
recipes.desc: Spiced scrambled eggs with onions and tomatoes - perfect for breakfast or dinner.
steps: Beat eggs with salt and turmeric in a bowl.
Heat oil in pan, sauté minced garlic and ginger.
Add diced onion, cook until translucent.
Add chopped tomato, cook until soft.
Pour beaten eggs, scramble gently on low heat.
Garnish with fresh coriander and serve hot.

ecoImpact.foodWasteSaved: Used leftover vegetables and day-old eggs
ecoImpact.carbonSaved: Reduced 0.3 kg CO₂ vs ordering restaurant breakfast

recipes.tip: Use slightly older eggs for better scrambling texture and to reduce food waste.

recipes.title: Aloo Paratha
recipes.desc: Traditional stuffed flatbread with spiced potato filling, served with yogurt.
steps: Boil and mash potatoes with spices, ginger-garlic paste.
Mix finely chopped onion into potato filling.
Make dough using bread flour and water.
Roll dough, stuff with potato mixture, seal edges.
Cook paratha on hot tawa with oil until golden.
Serve hot with fresh yogurt and pickle.

ecoImpact.foodWasteSaved: Used leftover boiled potatoes and stale bread flour
ecoImpact.carbonSaved: Reduced 0.5 kg CO₂ vs buying frozen parathas

recipes.tip: Make extra filling and freeze for quick parathas throughout the week.

recipes.title: Chicken Biryani
recipes.desc: Aromatic layered rice dish with marinated chicken and fragrant spices.
steps: Marinate chicken with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste and spices.
Deep fry sliced onions until golden, drain on paper.
Cook marinated chicken until 80% done.
Boil rice with whole spices until 70% cooked.
Layer rice and chicken alternately, top with fried onions.
Cook on high heat for 2 mins, then dum for 30 mins.

ecoImpact.foodWasteSaved: Used chicken parts that might otherwise be discarded
ecoImpact.carbonSaved: Reduced 1.2 kg CO₂ vs ordering restaurant biryani

recipes.tip: Save fried onion oil for cooking other dishes and use chicken bones for stock.

recipes.title: Mixed Vegetable Curry
recipes.desc: Hearty curry with cauliflower, peas, carrot and potatoes in spiced gravy.
steps: Cut all vegetables into similar sized pieces.
Heat oil, sauté onions until translucent.
Add ginger paste and chopped tomatoes.
Add harder vegetables first (potato, carrot), then cauliflower.
Add peas last with turmeric, salt and water.
Cover and cook until vegetables are tender.

ecoImpact.foodWasteSaved: Used vegetable scraps and slightly wilted vegetables
ecoImpact.carbonSaved: Reduced 0.4 kg CO₂ vs buying pre-cut frozen vegetables

recipes.tip: Save vegetable peels for compost and use the nutrient-rich cooking water for plants.

recipes.title: Masala Bread Toast
recipes.desc: Crispy buttered toast topped with spiced vegetables and cheese.
steps: Toast bread slices until lightly golden.
Butter the toast while warm.
Mix diced capsicum, tomato, onion with salt and pepper.
Spread ketchup on buttered toast.
Top with vegetable mixture and grated cheese.
Grill for 3-4 minutes until cheese melts.

ecoImpact.foodWasteSaved: Used day-old bread and vegetable scraps
ecoImpact.carbonSaved: Reduced 0.2 kg CO₂ vs buying packaged sandwiches

recipes.tip: Use bread that's slightly stale for better texture and save cheese rinds for soups.

recipes.title: Fish Curry
recipes.desc: Tangy coconut-based fish curry with tomatoes and aromatic spices.
steps: Marinate fish pieces with turmeric, salt and lemon juice.
Heat oil, fry fish lightly and set aside.
Sauté sliced onions until golden brown.
Add ginger-garlic paste, cook for 2 minutes.
Add chopped tomatoes and spices, cook until soft.
Gently add fried fish, simmer for 8-10 minutes.

ecoImpact.foodWasteSaved: Used fish offcuts and overripe tomatoes
ecoImpact.carbonSaved: Reduced 0.8 kg CO₂ vs buying packaged fish curry

recipes.tip: Save fish bones for making nutritious stock and use tomato seeds for growing plants.

recipes.title: Pasta in White Sauce
recipes.desc: Creamy pasta with vegetables in a rich milk-based white sauce.
steps: Boil pasta with salt until al dente, drain and reserve water.
Heat butter, sauté minced garlic until fragrant.
Add sliced mushrooms and capsicum, cook until tender.
Pour milk gradually, whisk to avoid lumps.
Add cooked pasta, season with salt, pepper and oregano.
Top with grated cheese and serve immediately.

ecoImpact.foodWasteSaved: Used slightly wilted vegetables and pasta water for plants
ecoImpact.carbonSaved: Reduced 0.5 kg CO₂ vs ordering restaurant pasta

recipes.tip: Save starchy pasta water for making bread and use vegetable trimmings for stock.

recipes.title: Stuffed Capsicum
recipes.desc: Bell peppers stuffed with spiced rice, beans and vegetables.
steps: Cut tops off capsicums, remove seeds and membranes.
Cook rice with beans until tender, let cool.
Sauté diced onions, garlic and tomatoes.
Mix cooked rice-beans with sautéed vegetables and corn.
Season stuffing with turmeric and salt.
Stuff capsicums, cover with foil and bake 30 minutes at 180°C.

ecoImpact.foodWasteSaved: Used leftover rice and slightly overripe capsicums
ecoImpact.carbonSaved: Reduced 0.4 kg CO₂ vs buying frozen stuffed peppers

recipes.tip: Use capsicum tops and seeds for making vegetable stock and compost scraps.

recipes.title: Banana Honey Smoothie
recipes.desc: Creamy smoothie with ripe bananas, milk and honey - perfect healthy drink.
steps: Peel and chop overripe bananas and apple.
Add all fruits to blender with yogurt.
Pour cold milk and add honey.
Add a pinch of salt and lemon juice.
Blend until smooth and creamy.
Garnish with fresh coriander and serve chilled.

ecoImpact.foodWasteSaved: Used overripe bananas and bruised apple
ecoImpact.carbonSaved: Reduced 0.2 kg CO₂ vs buying packaged smoothies

recipes.tip: Save banana peels for composting and use apple cores for making natural pectin.

recipes.title: Spinach Cheese Paratha
recipes.desc: Nutritious flatbread stuffed with spinach and cheese, served with tangy yogurt.
steps: Blanch spinach, drain and chop finely.
Sauté minced onion, garlic, ginger until fragrant.
Mix spinach with grated cheese, spices and salt.
Make soft dough with bread flour and water.
Roll dough, stuff with spinach-cheese mixture.
Cook on tawa with oil until golden and crispy.

ecoImpact.foodWasteSaved: Used wilted spinach leaves and cheese ends
ecoImpact.carbonSaved: Reduced 0.4 kg CO₂ vs buying frozen stuffed parathas

recipes.tip: Use spinach stems for making green stock and save cheese water for kneading dough.

recipes.title: Mushroom Egg Curry
recipes.desc: Rich curry with boiled eggs and mushrooms in spiced tomato gravy.
steps: Boil eggs, peel and make shallow cuts.
Slice mushrooms and sauté until golden.
Heat oil, fry eggs lightly and set aside.
Sauté onions, add ginger-garlic paste.
Add chopped tomatoes and spices, cook well.
Add mushrooms and eggs, simmer for 10 minutes.

ecoImpact.foodWasteSaved: Used older eggs and mushroom stems
ecoImpact.carbonSaved: Reduced 0.5 kg CO₂ vs ordering restaurant curry

recipes.tip: Save eggshells for calcium-rich compost and use mushroom stems for vegetable stock.

recipes.title: Potato Cabbage Stir Fry
recipes.desc: Simple dry sabzi with potatoes and cabbage seasoned with mustard seeds.
steps: Cut potatoes into small cubes, shred cabbage.
Heat oil, add mustard seeds until they splutter.
Add minced ginger-garlic, sauté briefly.
Add potato cubes with turmeric and salt.
Cover and cook until potatoes are 80% done.
Add cabbage and spices, cook uncovered until tender.

ecoImpact.foodWasteSaved: Used outer cabbage leaves and small potatoes
ecoImpact.carbonSaved: Reduced 0.3 kg CO₂ vs buying pre-cut vegetables

recipes.tip: Save cabbage core for making sauerkraut and use potato peels for crispy snacks.

recipes.title: Orange Yogurt Lassi
recipes.desc: Refreshing citrus lassi with fresh orange juice and creamy yogurt.
steps: Extract fresh juice from oranges, strain if needed.
Whisk yogurt until smooth and creamy.
Add orange juice and cold milk to yogurt.
Mix in honey, salt and grated ginger.
Add a pinch of black pepper and lemon drops.
Blend well, chill and serve with ice.

ecoImpact.foodWasteSaved: Used slightly overripe oranges and day-old yogurt
ecoImpact.carbonSaved: Reduced 0.2 kg CO₂ vs buying packaged fruit drinks

recipes.tip: Save orange peels for making natural air freshener and use pulp for marmalade.

recipes.title: Chicken Lettuce Wraps
recipes.desc: Healthy wraps with spiced minced chicken and fresh vegetables in lettuce cups.
steps: Wash and separate lettuce leaves carefully.
Heat oil, sauté minced ginger-garlic.
Add diced onions, cook until translucent.
Add minced chicken, cook until browned.
Season with spices, salt and vinegar.
Serve hot chicken in lettuce cups with cucumber strips.

ecoImpact.foodWasteSaved: Used chicken trimmings and outer lettuce leaves
ecoImpact.carbonSaved: Reduced 0.6 kg CO₂ vs restaurant wraps

recipes.tip: Save lettuce stems for making green smoothies and use chicken fat for cooking other dishes.

recipes.title: Ham Cheese Sandwich
recipes.desc: Classic grilled sandwich with ham, cheese and vegetables with tangy mayonnaise.
steps: Butter bread slices on one side.
Mix mayonnaise with mustard and black pepper.
Spread mayo mixture on unbuttered side.
Layer ham, cheese, tomato slices and lettuce.
Add cucumber strips and cover with second slice.
Grill sandwich until golden and cheese melts.

ecoImpact.foodWasteSaved: Used day-old bread and vegetable trimmings
ecoImpact.carbonSaved: Reduced 0.3 kg CO₂ vs buying pre-made sandwiches

recipes.tip: Save bread crusts for making croutons and use vegetable peels for composting.

recipes.title: Spiced Apple Chutney
recipes.desc: Sweet and tangy chutney with apples, ginger and aromatic spices.
steps: Peel and dice apples, mince ginger and garlic.
Heat oil, sauté diced onions until soft.
Add ginger-garlic paste, cook for 1 minute.
Add apple pieces with turmeric and salt.
Cook until apples are soft but not mushy.
Add vinegar, honey and chili powder, simmer 5 minutes.

ecoImpact.foodWasteSaved: Used bruised apples and ginger ends
ecoImpact.carbonSaved: Reduced 0.2 kg CO₂ vs buying packaged chutney

recipes.tip: Save apple peels and cores for making natural pectin and use for jam-making.

recipes.title: Corn Cheese Cutlets
recipes.desc: Crispy fried cutlets filled with sweet corn and melted cheese.
steps: Boil and mash potatoes until smooth.
Sauté diced onions and ginger until soft.
Mix mashed potatoes with corn and grated cheese.
Season with salt and pepper, form into cutlets.
Make breadcrumbs from bread slices.
Dip cutlets in beaten egg, coat with breadcrumbs and deep fry.

ecoImpact.foodWasteSaved: Used leftover corn and stale bread
ecoImpact.carbonSaved: Reduced 0.4 kg CO₂ vs buying frozen cutlets

recipes.tip: Save potato peels for making crispy chips and reuse frying oil after straining.

recipes.title: Fish Tikka Masala
recipes.desc: Grilled fish in rich tomato-based curry with yogurt and aromatic spices.
steps: Marinate fish cubes with yogurt, half ginger-garlic and spices.
Grill marinated fish until lightly charred.
Sauté sliced onions until golden brown.
Add remaining ginger-garlic paste, cook well.
Add pureed tomatoes and spices, simmer 15 minutes.
Add grilled fish, simmer gently for 8-10 minutes.

ecoImpact.foodWasteSaved: Used fish scraps for tikka and overripe tomatoes
ecoImpact.carbonSaved: Reduced 0.8 kg CO₂ vs restaurant takeout

recipes.tip: Save fish bones for making nutritious broth and use tomato peels for composting.

recipes.title: Bean Sprout Salad
recipes.desc: Fresh crunchy salad with bean sprouts, vegetables and tangy lemon dressing.
steps: Blanch bean sprouts in boiling water for 2 minutes.
Drain and cool sprouts under cold water.
Dice cucumber, carrot, onion and tomato finely.
Mix all vegetables with sprouts in large bowl.
Whisk lemon juice with olive oil, salt and pepper.
Toss salad with dressing and fresh coriander.

ecoImpact.foodWasteSaved: Used home-sprouted beans and vegetable trimmings
ecoImpact.carbonSaved: Reduced 0.3 kg CO₂ vs buying packaged salads

recipes.tip: Sprout beans at home to reduce packaging waste and save vegetable peels for compost.
